Omit targets you do not have. windows may be one entry or a list in order of preference; optional jobs sets its build parallelism (default 8). windows-arm64 lists Windows ARM64 hosts the same way (-Target windows-arm64). wasm lists the Windows hosts that build the web release (-Target wasm, release-wasm.ps1), each with share, the UNC path of its work tree that the site is copied back from. upload is the download server the release upload scripts write to (scripts\release\upload-target.bat).
